target.title: refactor: remove stale internal deprecated compatibility
target.body:
Closes #105998

AI-assisted: Codex implemented and reviewed this maintainer-requested cleanup.

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a maintenance problem where internal aliases and compatibility wrappers remained indefinitely behind `@deprecated` markers, obscuring the canonical runtime APIs and preserving dead branches. The audited base had 347 markers across 120 non-test `src/` files outside `src/plugin-sdk/`.

## Why This Change Was Made

The sweep classifies every marker before changing it. Shipped plugin SDK, CLI/config, gateway/wire, and doctor/migration contracts remain intact; internal callers move to the canonical API; dead symbols and their dedicated assertions are deleted. Exact files owned by the concurrent dead-export and deprecated-SDK sweeps were left to those lanes, and this PR does not touch `scripts/deadcode-exports.baseline.mjs`.

### Triage summary

| Bucket | Markers | Files | Disposition |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 1. Legitimate | 337 | 113 | Retained: shipped SDK/API/config/wire contracts or explicit doctor/migration compatibility. |
| 2. Stale internal | 7 | 5 | Internal callers migrated; deprecated member deleted in the same subsystem commit. |
| 3. Dead | 3 | 3 | Zero-call symbols deleted; dedicated assertions removed rather than rewritten around the old symbol. |

`src/cron/types.ts` contains both a retained shipped state field and one removed internal execution milestone, so the file totals overlap by one. Seven files are completely cleared of markers.

### Bucket 1: retained-file rationale

Every retained file is listed below. Plugin SDK reachability was checked against the focused barrels and their transitive public types; direct examples include `agent-runtime`, `provider-stream`, `channel-inbound`, `channel-outbound`, `approval-*`, `infra-runtime`, `interactive-runtime`, `plugin-entry`, and `plugin-runtime`.

| Surface | Retained files | Rationale |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Agents/providers | `src/agents/agent-command.ts`, `src/agents/agent-runtime-id.ts`, `src/agents/agent-scope.ts`, `src/agents/anthropic-payload-policy.ts`, `src/agents/auth-profiles/constants.ts`, `src/agents/cli-credentials.ts`, `src/agents/copilot-dynamic-headers.ts`, `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/openrouter-model-capabilities.ts`, `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/params.ts`, `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/runs.ts`, `src/agents/gpt5-prompt-overlay.ts`, `src/agents/harness/types.ts`, `src/agents/model-auth-markers.ts`, `src/agents/model-catalog.ts`, `src/agents/openai-text-verbosity.ts`, `src/agents/runtime-plan/types.ts`, `src/agents/sessions/agent-session.ts`, `src/agents/sessions/resource-loader.ts` | Exported agent/provider/session SDK contracts, legacy `extension-api` run signature, or upstream provider payload compatibility. The inner `runAgentAttempt` alias was not reachable and was deleted. |
| Reply runtime | `src/auto-reply/reply-payload.ts`, `src/auto-reply/reply/history.ts`, `src/auto-reply/templating.ts` | Public reply/context/history SDK types plus persisted transcript compatibility. |
| Channels | `src/channels/direct-dm-access.ts`, `src/channels/inbound-event/context.ts`, `src/channels/mention-gating.ts`, `src/channels/message/inbound-reply-dispatch.ts`, `src/channels/message/send.ts`, `src/channels/plugins/outbound.types.ts`, `src/channels/plugins/outbound/interactive.ts`, `src/channels/plugins/target-parsing-loaded.ts`, `src/channels/plugins/types.core.ts`, `src/channels/turn/types.ts` | Published channel SDK adapter/message contracts. Target-parsing removals are coordinated with the concurrent dead-export lane. |
| CLI | `src/cli/config-set-input.ts`, `src/cli/gateway-cli/run-options.ts`, `src/cli/plugins-cli.ts`, `src/cli/plugins-uninstall-command.ts`, `src/commands/onboard-types.ts` | Shipped CLI flags/options and onboarding inputs require deprecation windows. |
| Config | `src/config/types.agent-defaults.ts`, `src/config/types.agents.ts`, `src/config/types.base.ts`, `src/config/types.channels.ts`, `src/config/types.cron.ts`, `src/config/types.discord.ts`, `src/config/types.gateway.ts`, `src/config/types.googlechat.ts`, `src/config/types.messages.ts`, `src/config/types.openclaw.ts`, `src/config/types.plugins.ts`, `src/config/types.slack.ts`, `src/config/types.telegram.ts`, `src/config/types.tools.ts`, `src/config/types.tts.ts`, `src/config/zod-schema.agents.ts`, `src/config/zod-schema.allowdeny.ts`, `src/config/zod-schema.session.ts` | Shipped config shapes or raw legacy inputs explicitly consumed by doctor/migration repair. |
| Persisted commitments | `src/commitments/types.ts` | Legacy stored fields are recognized only so migration strips unsafe historical content. |
| macOS/gateway wire | `src/crestodian/setup-inference.ts` | Older macOS clients still receive the documented gateway compatibility field. |
| Cron | `src/cron/service/state.ts`, `src/cron/types.ts` | Shipped gateway/cron status and persisted SQLite state compatibility. The unrelated internal watchdog milestone was removed. |
| Legacy extension entry | `src/extensionAPI.ts` | Explicit shipped `openclaw/extension-api` compatibility surface for external plugins. |
| Doctor | `src/flows/doctor-core-checks.ts` | Explicit SDK-facing doctor registration compatibility. |
| Approval/infra SDK | `src/infra/approval-gateway-resolver.ts`, `src/infra/approval-handler-adapter-runtime.ts`, `src/infra/approval-handler-runtime-types.ts`, `src/infra/approval-handler-runtime.ts`, `src/infra/approval-native-runtime.ts`, `src/infra/brew.ts`, `src/infra/dedupe.ts`, `src/infra/exec-approval-reply.ts`, `src/infra/exec-command-resolution.ts`, `src/infra/fs-safe.ts`, `src/infra/home-dir.ts`, `src/infra/net/fetch-guard.ts`, `src/infra/outbound/deliver-runtime.ts`, `src/infra/outbound/deliver.ts`, `src/infra/outbound/reply-payload-normalize.ts`, `src/infra/secret-file.ts` | Direct or transitive focused plugin-SDK exports. Review and the SDK-boundary typecheck restored four initially removed aliases after proving their public barrel reachability. |
| Interactive payloads | `src/interactive/payload.ts` | Published typed-action payload compatibility consumed by plugin SDK reply surfaces. |
| Provider streams | `src/llm/providers/stream-wrappers/anthropic-family-tool-payload-compat.ts`, `src/llm/providers/stream-wrappers/minimax.ts`, `src/llm/providers/stream-wrappers/moonshot-thinking.ts`, `src/llm/providers/stream-wrappers/openai.ts`, `src/llm/providers/stream-wrappers/proxy.ts`, `src/llm/providers/stream-wrappers/zai.ts` | Public provider-stream SDK contracts and dependency-backed provider wire compatibility. |
| Diagnostics | `src/logging/diagnostic.ts` | Published plugin diagnostic event contract. |
| Media | `src/media/audio.ts`, `src/media/fetch.ts`, `src/media-understanding/types.ts` | Published media SDK functions/types and external fetch-result compatibility. |
| Memory host | `src/memory-host-sdk/dreaming.ts` | Public memory-host status SDK surface. |
| Pairing | `src/pairing/pairing-store.ts` | Doctor/plugin migration helpers plus shipped conversation/pairing SDK reachability; coordinated with the dedicated deprecated-SDK sweep. |
| Plugin API/runtime | `src/plugins/agent-tool-result-middleware-types.ts`, `src/plugins/agent-tool-result-middleware.ts`, `src/plugins/compat/registry.ts`, `src/plugins/hook-before-agent-start.types.ts`, `src/plugins/hook-before-tool-call-result.ts`, `src/plugins/hook-types.ts`, `src/plugins/hooks.ts`, `src/plugins/manifest.ts`, `src/plugins/memory-state.ts`, `src/plugins/provider-auth-token.ts`, `src/plugins/provider-claude-thinking.ts`, `src/plugins/provider-model-compat.ts`, `src/plugins/provider-openai-chatgpt-oauth.ts`, `src/plugins/provider-replay-helpers.ts`, `src/plugins/runtime/runtime-channel.ts`, `src/plugins/runtime/runtime-tasks.types.ts`, `src/plugins/runtime/types-channel.ts`, `src/plugins/runtime/types-core.ts`, `src/plugins/runtime/types.ts`, `src/plugins/types.ts` | Shipped external plugin API, hooks, provider contracts, runtime objects, and compatibility registry. Exact dead exports are owned by the concurrent plugin sweep. |
| Proxy capture | `src/proxy-capture/env.ts`, `src/proxy-capture/paths.ts`, `src/proxy-capture/types.ts` | Public proxy-capture SDK contract and retired file-layout migration locators. |
| Routing | `src/routing/resolve-route.ts` | Published plugin routing contract. |

### Bucket 2: stale internal compatibility removed

| File | Markers | Change |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `src/infra/session-cost-usage.ts` | 1 | Removed `days`; callers use the canonical range/default contract. |
| `src/logging/timestamps.ts` | 1 | Replaced `formatLocalIsoWithOffset` with `formatTimestamp(..., { style: "long" })`; deleted dedicated alias assertions. |
| `src/gateway/channel-health-monitor.ts` | 3 | Migrated startup/connect/stale thresholds into the `timing` policy object. |
| `src/cron/types.ts` | 1 | Removed `firstModelCallStarted`; watchdog uses phase-specific execution milestones. |
| `src/media/parse.ts` | 1 | Removed singular `mediaUrl`; callers consume `mediaUrls[0]`. |

### Bucket 3: dead compatibility removed

| File | Deleted symbol |
| --- | --- |
| `src/agents/command/attempt-execution.ts` | Inner `deferTerminalLifecycleEnd` field; the shipped outer run parameter remains. |
| `src/agents/sandbox/docker.ts` | Unused `envSanitizationOptions` parameter. |
| `src/channels/plugins/catalog.ts` | Uncalled `listChannelPluginCatalogEntries`; contract helpers now use the explicit raw listing. |

## User Impact

No intended user-visible behavior change. Internal runtime code now has fewer aliases and fallback branches, while shipped SDK/config/wire and migration contracts retain their compatibility windows.

## Evidence

- Enumeration at base: 347 markers / 120 files; after: 337 markers / 113 files.
- Diff: non-test `src/` is 58 lines smaller; full PR is 113 lines smaller net.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxctj5am8jdcz4cja6aj1akr`: 10 focused Vitest shards, 16 files, 745 tests passed.
- Remote `pnpm check:changed`: conflict-marker gate passed; stopped at the existing main-branch TypeScript LOC drift tracked by #105981 before later lanes ran.
- Remote direct format, core lint, production typecheck, and core-test typecheck: running after the unrelated ratchet stop.
- Fresh `autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main`: pending final result.
